title: PrintPrepResult
description: Per-step print content for a decomposed Feldenkrais lesson: position, brief summary and verbatim quotes

steps.description: One entry for every step in the input, in order

step_number.description: Step number from the decomposition, unchanged

position.description: Short body configuration, e.g. 'On back; feet standing'; empty if unknown

brief_summary.description: One or two actionable sentences: movement, side, direction, coordination, observation

notable_quotes.description: Zero to seven exact excerpts from this step's own segments

segment_id.description: A segment assigned to this step

text.description: Exact contiguous substring of that segment, copied verbatim

editorial_notes.description: Material ambiguities a reader should see; usually empty
